id.description: Globally unique identifier for the domain.

name.description: A human-readable label for the domain.

branded.description: If `true`, this is a Nylas-branded `nylas.email` subdomain managed by Nylas. You can only have one free Nylas branded domain per organization and region. If `false`, this is a custom domain.

organization_id.description: The ID of the Nylas organization that owns the domain.

region.description: The Nylas data center region where the domain is registered.

verified_ownership.description: If `true`, the domain's ownership TXT record has been verified.

verified_dkim.description: If `true`, the domain's DKIM TXT record has been verified.

verified_spf.description: If `true`, the domain's SPF record has been verified.

verified_mx.description: If `true`, the domain's MX record has been verified.

verified_feedback.description: If `true`, the domain's feedback MX record for bounce detection has been verified.

verified_dmarc.description: Currently not verified by Nylas. However, it is highly recommended to set DMARC to your desired value to prevent emails going to spam.

created_at.description: When the domain was created, in seconds using the Unix timestamp format.

updated_at.description: When the domain was last updated, in seconds using the Unix timestamp format.
